user.title: Connect Solariance
user.description: Paste a personal API token. Create one at {token_url} (Account → Developer → Manage API Tokens). “Read only” is enough for the forecast; for the production or irradiance upload, choose “Read and upload measured data”.

data_description.api_token: The token is checked by listing your systems.

system.title: Choose a system
system.description: Each Solariance system becomes its own entry. Add the integration again for another system.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token for {name}
reauth_confirm.description: Solariance refused the stored token (revoked or expired). Paste a new one from {token_url}.

error.invalid_auth: Solariance refused this token. Check that it was copied completely and is still active.
error.cannot_connect: Solariance could not be reached. Try again in a moment.
error.rate_limited: Your account's hourly request limit is used up. Try again later.
error.no_systems: This account has no PV system yet. Create one in the Solariance app first.
error.system_not_in_account: This token belongs to an account without this system.

abort.already_configured: Every system of this account is already set up.

data.upload_sensor: Upload the production of this sensor (optional)
data.irradiance_sensor: Upload the irradiance of this sensor (optional)

data_description.scan_interval: The forecast changes with each weather model run, a few times a day. Free and Plus accounts share 30 forecast requests per hour with the Solariance app.
data_description.upload_sensor: Your PV production energy sensor (kWh, total increasing). Every hour the last 48 hourly values go to Solariance to calibrate your forecast. Solariance only fills hours it does not have, so it never replaces what you uploaded yourself. Needs an API token with the permission “Read and upload measured data” (or “Read and write”) and the measured-data opt-in in your Solariance account.
data_description.irradiance_sensor: A sensor that measures solar irradiance in W/m² (a pyranometer, a reference cell or a weather station; light sensors in lux do not qualify). Every 10 minutes its 5-minute means of the last 2 hours go to Solariance, once an hour those of the last 48 hours, to sharpen your system's forecast. Solariance only fills values it does not have yet. Needs an API token with the permission “Read and upload measured data” (or “Read and write”) and the measured-data opt-in in your Solariance account. Leave empty to switch it off.

data_description.irradiance_plane: Horizontal: lying flat, as on most weather stations. Module plane: tilted like your PV modules.

irradiance_module.title: Sensor position
irradiance_module.description: Tilt and orientation of the sensor, prefilled with your system's largest roof face when Solariance has it.

data_description.irradiance_azimuth: Clockwise from north: 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west. A sensor moved to another position later starts a new series in Solariance.

error.not_irradiance: Choose a sensor with the device class irradiance (W/m²). Illuminance sensors (lux) cannot be used.
error.unsupported_unit: This sensor's unit cannot be converted to W/m².
error.no_statistics: This sensor keeps no statistics in Home Assistant (it needs the state class measurement).

rate_limited.message: The account's hourly request limit is used up; the forecast is fetched again when it resets.

system_paused.message: Solariance has paused this system because your plan does not cover it (more systems or a larger system than the plan allows). Change your plan or remove a system at solariance.de; the forecast is checked again hourly.

no_forecast_yet.message: Solariance has not computed a forecast for this system yet.

unreadable_forecast.message: Solariance answered with a forecast this integration cannot read.

entry_not_found.message: No Solariance entry with the ID {entry_id}.

entry_not_loaded.message: {name} has no forecast loaded right now.

system_not_in_account.message: This system is no longer in the Solariance account the API token belongs to (deleted, or the token is another account's). Remove this entry, or add the system again with a token of the account that has it; it is checked again hourly.

refused.message: Solariance refused the request ({reason}). The token is fine; it is asked again hourly.

get_forecast.name: Get forecast
get_forecast.description: Returns the forecast of a Solariance system as response data.

day.name: Day
day.description: 0 = today, 1 = tomorrow, … Leave empty for every day available.

find_surplus_window.name: Find surplus window
find_surplus_window.description: Finds the time window in which a load is covered best by the forecast solar surplus, e.g. to start a dishwasher or charge a car.

load_kw.name: Load
load_kw.description: Power the device draws while running.

baseline_kw.name: Base load
baseline_kw.description: What the home draws anyway; only power above it counts as surplus.

day.name: Day
day.description: 0 = today (only windows that have not started), 1 = tomorrow, …

feed_in_tariff_eur_per_kwh.name: Feed-in tariff
feed_in_tariff_eur_per_kwh.description: Optional: subtracted from the price for the saving.

system_not_in_account.title: {title}: system no longer in the account
system_not_in_account.description: Solariance says the system of "{title}" is not in the account the API token belongs to: it was deleted at solariance.de, or the token is another account's. A new token for the same account will not bring it back. Remove this entry, or add the system again with a token of the account that has it. Home Assistant checks again hourly and closes this issue when the system answers.

system_paused.title: Solariance system paused
system_paused.description: “{name}” is paused. Its sensors stay unavailable until the system is active again in your Solariance account.

system_paused_kwp_limit.title: Solariance system paused
system_paused_kwp_limit.description: “{name}” is paused: the system is larger than your account currently includes. Its sensors stay unavailable until the system is active again in your Solariance account.

system_paused_system_limit.title: Solariance system paused
system_paused_system_limit.description: “{name}” is paused: your account currently includes fewer systems than you have set up. Its sensors stay unavailable until the system is active again in your Solariance account.

confirm.title: Start a new irradiance series
confirm.description: Solariance already holds values for the irradiance sensor id {sensor_id} of “{title}” with a different position, and a sensor's position cannot change once it has values. The irradiance upload is stopped. Submit to go on under a new sensor id; the values stored under the old id stay there. If the position in the options is wrong, correct it under Configure instead: a new position gets a new id by itself.

abort.entry_not_found: This Solariance entry no longer exists.
